title: Proteomic and transcriptomic analyses identify the role of RBM25 in the malignant progression of glioma.
authors: Xu, Xiangdi; Wang, Jiahao; Xue, Mingming; Feng, Longkai
one_liner_zh: 该文通过蛋白质组和转录组分析及机器学习筛选胶质瘤关键基因RBM25，虽涉及ChIP验证转录因子-基因互作，但核心是肿瘤标志物与功能实验，非TF-DNA结合机制建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Glioma is a primary tumor derived from central nervous system glial cells. RNA binding motif protein 25 (RBM25) has been implicated in glioma progression, yet its underlying molecular mechanism remains incompletely understood. METHODS: In this study, glioma-related datasets were retrieved from the Proteomic Data Commons (PDC) and Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) databases. Core glioma-associated targets were screened using machine learning algorithms. Protein expression was assessed by Western blot, while migration, and invasion, cell cycle and apoptosis were analyzed by Transwell assay and flow cytometry. Chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) and dual-luciferase reporter assays were used to validate the interaction between transcription factors and genes. RESULTS: Proteomic analysis revealed distinct differences between glioma and control groups, with differentially expressed proteins mainly enriched in mitochondrial energy metabolism, synaptic function, and neurodegenerative disease pathways. Transcriptomic profiles also exhibited significant alterations, with RBM25 and HSPA8 showing consistent changes at both protein and RNA levels. Multiple machine learning models identified RBM25, NKTR, MAP2K6, TRAPPC3, and HSPA8 as key genes associated with glioma, with RBM25 and NKTR showing strong relevance in model-based feature selection. RBM25 was upregulated in glioma and linked to neuronal signaling pathways, whereas HSPA8 and TRAPPC3 were downregulated. RBM25 knockdown suppressed glioma cell proliferation, migration, and invasion, and induced cell cycle arrest and apoptosis. CONCLUSION: RBM25 contributes to glioma malignancy and may serve as a potential biomarker and therapeutic target for glioma.
abstract_zh: 背景：胶质瘤是一种源自中枢神经系统胶质细胞的原发性肿瘤。RNA结合基序蛋白25（RBM25）已被认为与胶质瘤进展相关，但其潜在分子机制尚未完全阐明。方法：本研究从蛋白质组数据共享库（PDC）和基因表达综合库（GEO）中检索了胶质瘤相关数据集。使用机器学习算法筛选核心胶质瘤相关靶点。通过Western blot评估蛋白表达，而迁移、侵袭、细胞周期和凋亡则通过Transwell实验和流式细胞术分析。采用染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）和双荧光素酶报告基因实验验证转录因子与基因之间的相互作用。结果：蛋白质组学分析显示胶质瘤组与对照组之间存在显著差异，差异表达蛋白主要富集于线粒体能量代谢、突触功能和神经退行性疾病通路。转录组谱也表现出显著变化，其中RBM25和HSPA8在蛋白质和RNA水平上均显示出一致的变化。多种机器学习模型将RBM25、NKTR、MAP2K6、TRAPPC3和HSPA8识别为与胶质瘤相关的关键基因，其中RBM25和NKTR在基于模型的特征选择中显示出强相关性。RBM25在胶质瘤中上调，并与神经元信号通路相关，而HSPA8和TRAPPC3则下调。RBM25敲低抑制了胶质瘤细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，并诱导细胞周期阻滞和凋亡。结论：RBM25促进胶质瘤恶性程度，可能作为胶质瘤的潜在生物标志物和治疗靶点。
